description: This Dart source file defines the ReaderProvider class, which manages the state related to reading a book in a Flutter app. It handles opening books, loading chapters, navigating between chapters, and bookmarks, interacting with services and models.

classes.name: ReaderProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages the current reading state, including book details, chapter content, progress, and bookmarks.

methods.name: openBook
methods.description: Opens a book given its composed ID, loads its details, reading progress, and the current chapter content.

methods.name: _loadChapter
methods.description: Loads the content of the current chapter based on the current chapter index.

methods.name: nextChapter
methods.description: Navigates to the next chapter if available and updates progress.

methods.name: prevChapter
methods.description: Navigates to the previous chapter if available and updates progress.

methods.name: addBookmark
methods.description: Adds a bookmark at a specified position within the current chapter and updates storage.
